description: Find the provisions that answer a legal question, in EU and national legislation: use it first when the user asks what the law says about something (withdrawal rights, data retention, zero-rating of food) without citing an article. Ranked full-text search over provision text; add a jurisdiction ('EU', 'GB', 'FR', 'ES') to narrow it. Results carry work, eId, status and provenance — feed a hit's work+eId to lookup_provision for the complete payload.

jurisdiction.description: ISO country filter, e.g. 'GB' (the UK), 'FR', 'ES', 'EU'. 'UK' is read as 'GB'.

language.description: Restrict to a text language, e.g. 'eng'.

name: search_legislation

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.

title: Full-text search across the corpus
